name: move_ssubset
statement: lemma move_ssubset {S : Board} {m : ℕ × ℤ} (h : m ∈ moves S) : move S m ⊂ S
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [move, Finset.filter_ssubset]
  refine ⟨m.2, h.1, ?_⟩
  simp

name: condition_one
statement: lemma condition_one : Condition 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Condition]
  intro d h
  have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h
  interval_cases d <;> decide

statement: lemma condition_two : Condition 2

  rw [Condition]

  have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h
  interval_cases d <;> decide

name: three_dvd_two_pow_odd_add_one
statement: lemma three_dvd_two_pow_odd_add_one {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) : 3 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  rw [Nat.pow_add_one, pow_mul, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
  norm_num

name: add_one_dvd_of_dvd_not_prime
statement:
lemma add_one_dvd_of_dvd_not_prime {n d : ℕ} (hc : Condition n) (hd : d ∣ n)
    (hd1 : ¬(d + 1).Prime) : d + 1 ∣ n
proof: := (hc d hd).resolve_right hd1

name: add_one_prime_of_dvd_not_dvd
statement:
lemma add_one_prime_of_dvd_not_dvd {n d : ℕ} (hc : Condition n) (hd : d ∣ n)
    (hd1 : ¬d + 1 ∣ n) : (d + 1).Prime
proof: := (hc d hd).resolve_left hd1

name: le_two_of_pow_two
statement: lemma le_two_of_pow_two {k : ℕ} (hc : Condition (2 ^ k)) : k ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [not_le, ← Nat.succ_le_iff] at h
  norm_num at h
  have h9 : 2 ^ 3 + 1 ∣ 2 ^ k := hc.add_one_dvd_of_dvd_not_prime (pow_dvd_pow _ h) (by norm_num)
  have h32 := Nat.prime_three.dvd_of_dvd_pow (Dvd.dvd.trans (by norm_num) h9)
  norm_num at h32

name: add_one_eq_two_pow_of_two_pow_mul_odd
statement:
lemma add_one_eq_two_pow_of_two_pow_mul_odd {k m : ℕ} (hc : Condition (2 ^ k * m)) (hm : Odd m)
    (hm1 : 1 < m) :
    ∃ t, 2 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ k ∧ m + 1 = 2 ^ t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (m + 1).Prime
  · rcases h.eq_two_or_odd' with ho | ho
    · omega
    · rw [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd] at ho
      exact False.elim (ho (hm.add_odd odd_one))
  · have hcm := hc.add_one_dvd_of_dvd_not_prime (dvd_mul_left _ _) h
    rw [Nat.Coprime.dvd_mul_right (by simp), Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two] at hcm
    rcases hcm with ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ht⟩
    by_contra ht2
    interval_cases t <;> omega

name: two_pow_add_one_prime
statement:
lemma two_pow_add_one_prime {k m t : ℕ} (hc : Condition (2 ^ k * m)) (ht2 : 2 ≤ t) (htk : t ≤ k)
    (htm : m + 1 = 2 ^ t) : (2 ^ k + 1).Prime
proof:
:= by
  refine hc.add_one_prime_of_dvd_not_dvd (dvd_mul_right (2 ^ k) m) ?_
  rw [Nat.Coprime.dvd_mul_left (by simp)]
  refine Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt ?_ ?_
  · by_contra h
    simp only [not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at h
    subst h
    rw [zero_add, eq_comm] at htm
    rw [pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (by decide) (by omega)] at htm
    simp at htm
  · calc m < 2 ^ t := by omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) htk
      _ < 2 ^ k + 1 := by omega

name: two_pow_sub_one_add_one_prime
statement:
lemma two_pow_sub_one_add_one_prime {k m t : ℕ} (hc : Condition (2 ^ k * m)) (ht2 : 2 ≤ t)
    (htk : t ≤ k) (htm : m + 1 = 2 ^ t) : (2 ^ (k - 1) + 1).Prime
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (n := k) (m := 1) (by omega), Nat.pow_add_one, mul_assoc] at hc
  by_cases hk2 : k = 2
  · subst hk2
    norm_num
  · refine hc.add_one_prime_of_dvd_not_dvd (dvd_mul_right (2 ^ (k - 1)) (2 * m)) ?_
    rw [Nat.Coprime.dvd_mul_left (by simp), Nat.Coprime.dvd_mul_left]
    · by_cases hk : k = t
      · subst hk
        have hp : 2 ^ k = 2 ^ (k - 1) * 2 := by
          rw [← Nat.pow_add_one]
          simp
          omega
        rw [hp] at htm
        intro h
        have h' : 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 ∣ 2 * (2 ^ (k - 1) + 1) - m := by
          exact Nat.dvd_sub (dvd_mul_left _ _) h
        have h3 : 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 ∣ 3 := by
          convert h'
          omega
        refine Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (by norm_num) ?_ h3
        calc 3 = 2 ^ 1 + 1 := by norm_num
          _ < 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 := by gcongr <;> omega
      · refine Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt ?_ ?_
        · by_contra h
          simp only [not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at h
          subst h
          rw [zero_add, eq_comm] at htm
          rw [pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (by decide) (by omega)] at htm
          simp at htm
        · calc m < 2 ^ t := by omega
            _ ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
            _ < 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    · suffices (2 * 2 ^ (k - 2) + 1).Coprime 2 by
        convert this using 2
        rw [← Nat.pow_add_one']
        congr
        omega
      simp

name: eq_two_of_two_pow_mul
statement:
lemma eq_two_of_two_pow_mul {k m t : ℕ} (hc : Condition (2 ^ k * m)) (ht2 : 2 ≤ t) (htk : t ≤ k)
    (htm : m + 1 = 2 ^ t) : k = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := hc.two_pow_add_one_prime ht2 htk htm
  have hp1 := hc.two_pow_sub_one_add_one_prime ht2 htk htm
  by_cases h : Even k
  · have h' : Odd (k - 1) := Nat.Even.sub_odd (by omega) h (by norm_num)
    have h3 : 3 ∣ 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 := three_dvd_two_pow_odd_add_one h'
    rw [hp1.dvd_iff_eq (by norm_num), ← eq_tsub_iff_add_eq_of_le (by norm_num)] at h3
    norm_num at h3
    rw [Nat.pow_eq_self_iff (by norm_num)] at h3
    omega
  · rw [Nat.not_even_iff_odd] at h
    have h3 : 3 ∣ 2 ^ k + 1 := three_dvd_two_pow_odd_add_one h
    rw [hp.dvd_iff_eq (by norm_num), ← eq_tsub_iff_add_eq_of_le (by norm_num)] at h3
    norm_num at h3
    rw [Nat.pow_eq_self_iff (by norm_num)] at h3
    omega

name: eq_one_or_two_or_four_or_twelve
statement:
lemma eq_one_or_two_or_four_or_twelve {n : ℕ} (hc : Condition n) (h : 0 < n) :
    n = 1 ∨ n = 2 ∨ n = 4 ∨ n = 12
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd h.ne' with ⟨k, m, hm, rfl⟩
  by_cases hm1 : m = 1
  · subst hm1
    rw [mul_one] at hc
    have hk := hc.le_two_of_pow_two
    interval_cases k <;> norm_num
  · have hm1' : 1 < m := by
      by_contra hm1'
      interval_cases m <;> omega
    rcases hc.add_one_eq_two_pow_of_two_pow_mul_odd hm hm1' with ⟨t, ht2, htk, htm⟩
    have hk2 := hc.eq_two_of_two_pow_mul ht2 htk htm
    subst hk2
    have ht2 : t = 2 := le_antisymm htk ht2
    subst ht2
    omega

name: result
statement:
theorem result {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) :
    Condition n ↔ n ∈ solutionSet
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hc ↦ ?_, fun hc ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact hc.eq_one_or_two_or_four_or_twelve h
  · simp_rw [solutionSet, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hc
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact condition_one
    · exact condition_two
    · exact condition_four
    · exact condition_twelve

name: zero_not_mem_x_to_finset
statement: lemma zero_not_mem_x_to_finset {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) : 0 ∉ (x_to_finset x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [x_to_finset, xmap, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_map,
             Finset.mem_range, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, true_and, not_exists, not_and]
  intro i _ _
  positivity

name: sum_two_pow_mul_sq_optimal_x
statement:
lemma sum_two_pow_mul_sq_optimal_x (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 2 ^ (i : ℕ) * optimal_x n i ^ 2 = n * (n + 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 n) = Finset.Icc 0 n := by
    rw [← zero_add 1, Finset.insert_Icc_add_one_left_eq_Icc n.zero_le]
  rw [sum_two_pow_mul_sq, optimal_x_to_finset, ← Finset.sum_insert_zero rfl (a := 0), h,
      ← Finset.Ico_succ_right_eq_Icc, Order.succ_eq_add_one, ← Finset.range_eq_Ico,
      Finset.sum_range_id, mul_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: result
statement:
theorem result (n : ℕ) : (∀ x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ, ∑ i, x i = n → answer n ≤
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 2 ^ (i : ℕ) * x i ^ 2) ∧
    ∃ x : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ, ∑ i, x i = n ∧
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 2 ^ (i : ℕ) * x i ^ 2 = answer n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x h ↦ ?_, optimal_x n, sum_optimal_x n, sum_two_pow_mul_sq_optimal_x n⟩
  convert le_sum_two_pow_mul_sq x using 1
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: HasRating.a_pos
statement:
lemma HasRating.a_pos {n a b : ℕ} {r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n}
    (h : HasRating a b r s) : 0 < a

name: HasRating.b_pos
statement:
lemma HasRating.b_pos {n a b : ℕ} {r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n}
    (h : HasRating a b r s) : 0 < b

name: HasRating.a_le_card
HasRating.a_le_n
statement:
lemma HasRating.a_le_n {n a b : ℕ} {r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n}
    (h : HasRating a b r s) : a ≤ n
proof:
:=
  calc a ≤ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i ↦ (r i s : ℕ) < b)).card := h.a_le_card
    _ ≤ Finset.univ.card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    _ = n := by simp

name: HasRating.sub_le
statement:
lemma HasRating.sub_le {n a b : ℕ} {r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n}
    (h : HasRating a b r s) : (a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha := h.b_pos
  have hb := h.a_le_n
  omega

name: HasRating.le_score
statement:
lemma HasRating.le_score {n a b : ℕ} {r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n}
    (h : HasRating a b r s) : (a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) ≤ score r s
proof:
:= by
  let ab : {x : ℕ × ℕ // HasRating x.1 x.2 r s} := ⟨(a, b), h⟩
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range (fun ab : {x : ℕ × ℕ // HasRating x.1 x.2 r s} ↦
      ((ab : ℕ × ℕ).1 : ℤ) - ((ab : ℕ × ℕ).2 : ℤ))) := by
    refine ⟨n - 1, ?_⟩
    simp only [mem_upperBounds, Set.mem_range, Subtype.exists, exists_prop, Prod.exists,
               forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    rintro z a b hab rfl
    exact hab.sub_le
  exact le_ciSup hb ab

name: hasRating_n_n
statement:
lemma hasRating_n_n {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (s : Fin n) :
    HasRating n n r s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hn, hn, Eq.le ?_⟩
  convert (Finset.card_univ (α := Fin n)).symm <;> simp

name: score_le_of_forall_hasRating_le
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty ({x : ℕ × ℕ // HasRating x.1 x.2 r s}) := ⟨⟨(n, n), hasRating_n_n hn r s⟩⟩
  have hle : ∀ ab : {x : ℕ × ℕ // HasRating x.1 x.2 r s},
      ((ab : ℕ × ℕ).1 : ℤ) - ((ab : ℕ × ℕ).2 : ℤ) ≤ m := fun ab ↦ h _ _ ab.property
  exact ciSup_le hle

name: score_eq_of_hasRating_of_forall_hasRating_le
statement:
lemma score_eq_of_hasRating_of_forall_hasRating_le {n a b : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n} (h : HasRating a b r s)
    (hle : ∀ a' b', HasRating a' b' r s → (a' : ℤ) - (b' : ℤ) ≤ (a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) :
    score r s = (a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (score_le_of_forall_hasRating_le hn hle) h.le_score

name: hasRating_const
statement:
lemma hasRating_const {n a b : ℕ} {r : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {s : Fin n} :
    HasRating a b (Function.const _ r) s ↔ 0 < a ∧ a ≤ n ∧ (r s : ℕ) < b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨ha, -, h⟩
    refine ⟨ha, h.trans ?_, ?_⟩
    · convert Finset.card_filter_le _ _
      simp
    · by_contra hnlt
      simp [hnlt] at h
      omega
  · exact ⟨h.1, by omega, by simp [h.2.1, h.2.2]⟩

name: score_const
statement:
lemma score_const {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (s : Fin n) :
    score (Function.const _ r) s = n - (1 + (r s : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  convert score_eq_of_hasRating_of_forall_hasRating_le hn ?_ ?_
  · rw [hasRating_const]
    simp [hn]
  · simp_rw [hasRating_const]
    omega

name: sum_score_const
statement:
lemma sum_score_const {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    ∑ s, score (Function.const _ r) s = n * (n - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.eq_ediv_of_mul_eq_right (by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0) ?_
  simp_rw [score_const hn, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have h := r.sum_comp Finset.univ (fun x ↦ ((x : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (Finset.coe_univ (α := Fin n) ▸ Set.subset_univ _)
  rw [h, ← Finset.sum_range, ← Nat.cast_sum (Finset.range n), mul_comm, sub_mul, add_mul,
      (by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) = (2 : ℕ)), ← Nat.cast_mul, Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two]
  push_cast
  rw [(by omega : ((n - 1) : ℕ) = ((n - 1) : ℤ))]
  simp
  ring

name: score_mul_n_le_sum_weight
statement:
lemma score_mul_n_le_sum_weight {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (s : Fin n) : score r s * n ≤ ∑ i, (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ a b, HasRating a b r s → ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) * n ≤ ∑ i, (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    intro a b h
    have han : a ≤ n := h.a_le_n
    by_cases hb : b ≤ n
    · rcases h with ⟨-, hb, h⟩
      calc ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) * n = a * n - b * n := by ring
        _ ≤ a * n - b * a := by gcongr
        _ = a * (n - b) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i ↦ (r i s : ℕ) < b)).card * (n - b) := by
          gcongr
          omega
        _ = ∑ _ ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i ↦ (r i s : ℕ) < b)),
              (n - b : ℤ) := by simp [mul_sub]
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun i ↦ (r i s : ℕ) < b)),
              (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          simp_rw [sub_sub]
          gcongr with i hi
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi
          omega
        _ ≤ ∑ i, (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ) := Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (by omega)
    · calc ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) * n ≤ 0 := by rw [mul_nonpos_iff]; omega
        _ ≤ ∑ i, (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ) := Finset.sum_nonneg (by omega)
  rw [← Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le (mod_cast hn)]
  refine score_le_of_forall_hasRating_le hn (fun a b hab ↦ ?_)
  rw [Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le (mod_cast hn)]
  exact h a b hab

name: sum_score_mul_n_le
statement:
lemma sum_score_mul_n_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (∑ s, score r s) * n ≤ n * (n * (n - 1) / 2)
proof:
:=
  calc (∑ s, score r s) * n = ∑ s, score r s * n := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ s, ∑ i, (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ) := by gcongr; exact score_mul_n_le_sum_weight hn _ _
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ s, (n - 1 - (r i s : ℕ) : ℤ) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, (n * (n - 1) / 2 : ℤ) := by
      congr with i
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have h := (r i).sum_comp Finset.univ (fun x ↦ ((x : ℕ) : ℤ))
        (Finset.coe_univ (α := Fin n) ▸ Set.subset_univ _)
      rw [h, ← Finset.sum_range, ← Nat.cast_sum (Finset.range n)]
      refine Int.eq_ediv_of_mul_eq_right (by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0) ?_
      simp_rw [mul_sub, mul_comm (2 : ℤ)]
      rw [(by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) = (2 : ℕ)), ← Nat.cast_mul, Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two]
      push_cast
      rw [(by omega: ((n - 1) : ℕ) = ((n - 1) : ℤ))]
      simp
      ring
    _ = n * (n * (n - 1) / 2) := by simp

name: sum_score_le
statement:
lemma sum_score_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (∑ s, score r s) ≤ (n * (n - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_score_mul_n_le hn r
  rw [mul_comm] at h
  simpa [hn] using h

name: result
statement:
theorem result {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∀ r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ s, score r s ≤ answer n) ∧
    ∃ r : Fin n → Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∑ s, score r s = answer n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun r ↦ sum_score_le hn r, Function.const _ (Equiv.refl _), sum_score_const hn _⟩
